name: Yoshinogawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yoshinogawa city emblem in green and navy: green and navy stylised strokes, like leaves and water.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshinogawa, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Yoshinogawa city emblem — green and navy stylised strokes, like leaves and water
